<en> When read, increases the Explosives skill. The lower the skill, the larger the gain. Single-use publication. Read only in the bunker. Temporary penalties do not improve these terms. Another order pauses reading; use again to resume. Progress percentage is saved; terms adjust if the skill increases. One copy is consumed only on successful completion, never at skill 100.

One copy is consumed only on successful completion, never at skill 100.
